data.body:
Brainstorm Phase 1 complete; Phase 2 in progress — paused to commit/push suggestion-record.sh fix. State to resume from:

- Approach selected: Option A — bash trailer + pr-owned-by-session.sh helper + fail-closed wrap at 6 destructive call sites + CLAUDE.md rule + CI grep test
- Marker: Session-Id: $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID + Generated-By: dso-merge-to-main-pr.sh as trailer on PR body at create
- Ownership semantics: fail-closed universally (refuse + prompt user) on foreign OR absent marker
- Session ID source: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID runtime contract — assume always set; no fallback handling
- Out of scope: GitHub labels (deferred), retro marking of existing PRs, ownership transfer
- Surface: merge-to-main-pr.sh (1 file, multiple edits); pr-owned-by-session.sh (new); debug-everything/SKILL.md, phase-10-merge-verify.md, end-session/SKILL.md (one call-site each); CLAUDE.md rule; CI grep test under plugins/dso/tests/

Pre-flight cleanup already done in this session (committed separately): suggestion-record.sh variable rename CLAUDE_SESSION_ID -> CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID (the legacy var was dead code; rename + drop fallback).

Still to do when resumed: Phase 2 Step 2.25 cross-epic scan (8 batches staged in /tmp/xscan-batch-{0..7}.json); Red Team + Blue Team + 3 fidelity reviewers (agent-clarity, scope, value) + bot-psychologist; approval gate; Phase 3 epic creation + PIL + tag + sentinel; close fe66-f05b as superseded.
